sections.heading: THE REALITY
sections.body: A careers page must not suggest the company is hiring for positions that have not been approved or posted.

sections.heading: HOW TO APPROACH IT
sections.body: List verified open roles when there are any. Separately explain partner/affiliate opportunities, which are not automatically employee positions and may have different terms.

sections.heading: YOUR NEXT MOVE
sections.body: If no vacancies are published, state that no verified current openings are listed and route interested parties to the appropriate general contact or partner page.
